notable_anecdotes.description: Six baseline complaints documented in CJ's intake with Dr. Morato: (1) prostate cancer, stage Pirads 4, under control via Luprolex hormones and daily Duodart; (2) sharp lumbar pain radiating through legs to feet; (3) knee pain; (4) carpal tunnel syndrome; (5) varicose veins; and (6) general body and mental weakness. CJ was advised to stop Pletaal SR 100 mg blood thinner for two days.
notable_anecdotes.purpose: Complete clinical baseline against which Part 4 will measure outcomes.

notable_anecdotes.description: Tuesday July 16 protocol: nurse Agie extracted blood for chemistry; Cathy Serrano (Filipino assistant) asked CJ to gargle 30 seconds and swallow 10 mL of liquid Cortisone -- which he 'promptly expelled,' coughing violently with nose drips, tear flows, and heavy sweating for two hours requiring towel and bed rest. After calming down, a female nurse had him prone face-down; at 10:21 a.m., Dr. Morato came in with 10 syringes (about 30 cc each, two or three larger, 'mostly pink in color or cloudy white in appearance') and injected them in rapid succession -- 5 on each side of the buttocks -- in six minutes timed by nurse Leonor; CJ remained motionless prone for 30 minutes.
notable_anecdotes.purpose: Step-by-step clinical chronicle from blood draw through Cortisone gargle to buttocks injection.

notable_anecdotes.description: Dr. Morato's biography: he studied and practiced medicine in Berlin; as a medical staff member at the Villa Medica in Germany, he witnessed the 'miraculous healing' of a young boy 'afflicted with advanced Parkinson's with his saliva drooling, confined to a wheelchair, unable to stand up and walk, and with stiff hand muscles' -- '48 hours after the LCT injections, he walked, his saliva drooling ceased, and looked very normal.' Immensely impressed, Morato devoted his remaining career to 'alternative medicine' and moved to the Block Clinic in 2023 after Villa Medica was closed by German authorities.
notable_anecdotes.purpose: Practitioner-witness story legitimizing the Filipino-physician connection.

notable_anecdotes.description: Block Clinic celebrity-patient roster: Pope Paul XII, Charles de Gaulle, Dwight Eisenhower, Madonna, Pablo Picasso, and 'other celebrities.' Dr. Siegfried Block was honored by Pope Paul XII as a member of the Pontifical Scientific Academy alongside Alexander Fleming (discoverer of penicillin). His daughter Dr. Petra Block is current medical director; grandson Dr. Daniel Block is administrative director.

one_paragraph_summary: Part 3 of the stem-cell series is a procedural walkthrough of CJ Panganiban's July 14-19, 2024 Living Cell Therapy treatment at the Block Clinic in Germany. Nine friends accompanied him; because the Lenggries hotel was under renovation, the LCT was conducted in Bad Tölz at the BSW Isarwinkel Hotel (CJ in Room 220, daughter Len and personal nurse Leonor Ching in Room 219). After arrival on Sunday July 14, male nurse Almer took CJ's ECG and Filipino physician Dr. Andres Morato (Berlin-trained, who joined the Block Clinic in 2023 after Villa Medica was closed by German authorities) took CJ's medical history, documenting six baseline complaints: prostate cancer at stage Pirads 4 (managed with Luprolex hormones and daily Duodart), sharp lumbar pain radiating to feet, knee pain, carpal tunnel syndrome, varicose veins, and general weakness -- with instructions to suspend Pletaal SR 100 mg blood thinner for two days. Monday afternoon, Dr. Petra Block briefed CJ via Morato's English-to-German translation, explaining LCT's organ-specific matching principle (embryo heart parts for heart ailments, lung parts for lung ailments) and the 18,500-euro normal fee inclusive of full board with group discounts available. Tuesday July 16 was injection day: nurse Agie drew blood; Cathy Serrano (Filipino clinic assistant) had CJ gargle and swallow 10 mL of liquid Cortisone -- which CJ promptly expelled with two hours of violent coughing, nose drips, tears, and heavy sweating; then prone face-down, at 10:21 a.m. Dr. Morato administered 10 syringes (about 30 cc each, mostly pink or cloudy white) in rapid succession -- five per buttocks side -- in six minutes timed by nurse Leonor, followed by 30-minute prone immobility. Wednesday July 17 brought room confinement with all meals delivered. Morato shared the practitioner-witness story that converted him to 'alternative medicine': a young Parkinson's-afflicted boy at Villa Medica who walked again 48 hours after LCT injections. Thursday brought a Lake Tegernsee cruise with lunch at Seehotel zur Post; Friday brought 9:30 a.m. checkout, an Augsburg tour, and the Munich Airport return. The Block Clinic lineage (Niehans 1931 founder, Siegfried as Niehans's assistant honored by Pope Paul XII at the Pontifical Scientific Academy alongside Fleming, daughter Petra as current medical director, grandson Daniel as administrative director) and celebrity patient roster (Pope Paul XII, de Gaulle, Eisenhower, Madonna, Picasso) frame the credentials story.
